name: DigitalJS
tagline: The circuit lives in the GIF. Invite shares the bench. It works on a plane.
description:
Press Play and a 4-bit counter climbs in front of you — lamps, hex, the incrementer ticking. Close it, open it later, the same netlist is still loaded, because the file is the save. Press Invite and a friend lands on that bench; they can flip the buttons too.

Samples: a counter, a 4-bit add/subtract, a full adder made of two half-adders, an LFSR, a D-latch. Paste DigitalJS JSON of your own. Drag to pan, pinch or +/− to zoom. On a phone the pins sit under the schematic so you do not have to hunt for a tiny button.

An unofficial port of DigitalJS by Marek Materzok. The original wants a page on the web; this copy is one GIF that runs offline.
